title: Sales Advisor (Nea Erythraia) / Εκπρόσωπος Πωλήσεων (Νέα Ερυθραία)
description:
About us
In 2023, FOURLIS Group entered into the fast growing sector of health and wellness with Holland & Barrett! So far, we count 10 physical retail stores operating in Attiki and Thessaloniki!
Our vision is to become a leading player in the health & wellness industry throughout the region of Greece, Romania and Bulgaria by opening 120 physical stores over time along with our Holland & Barrett e-shop!
Holland & Barrett International, established in 1870, is one of the Europe’s leading health and wellness retailers in providing a wide range of products in 4 key pillars - vitamins & supplements, natural beauty, health foods, and sports nutrition - with over 1.600 stores worldwide!
Do you want to become part of our health & wellness success story? If yes, then this is the right time to apply for the Sales Advisor position (full-time) for our shop-in-shop in Nea Erythraia (Attiki)!
Wellness begins with you, start your journey today!
 
The job
Sales Advisors are vital to our success! Yes, you will need to be able to carry out regular tasks for the optimal store operation like delivering exceptional customer service, making sales, replenishing shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy, but there's so much more to it than that! Sales Advisors are experts in giving our customers the advice they need to live healthier, happier lives. And you will be ready for whatever question, query or lifestyle goal is thrown your way, as we make sure you complete a specialized “Qualified to Advise” training that is designed in order for you to thrive in your role! The training is challenging, but it will turn you into a health and wellness expert, ready to advise our customers on whatever they need! If you want to go on and specialize in sports, nutrition, beauty or aromatherapy, we can help you to do that too.
 
The person
To be successful, we'd like you to show us that you have:

Passion and enthusiasm for our products, nutritional supplements, natural beauty and healthy living
Compassionate and consultative approach to customers
Motivation to study and ability to undertake computer-based study to support the product knowledge required to achieve an accredited qualification
Ability to work well within a team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to effectively multi-task
Positive attitude and achievement drive
At least one (1) year of experience in sales/customer service
Good knowledge of the English language, both written and verbal
PC skills
Fulfilled military obligations (where applicable)

Considered as an asset:

Bachelor's Degree in Nutrition & Dietetic Science studies or Pharmacy studies or related field

 
We offer
We offer a competitive remuneration & benefits package (bonus scheme, medical plan, etc.), extensive and continuous training, as well as exceptional opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally in an exciting and empowering work environment!
If you want to join our team, please send us your complete resume!

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
The Volton Group Hellenic Energy S.A. is a Greek Company that operates dynamically and is developing at a rapid pace in the field of Electricity Supply and Trading, in the field of Natural Gas Energy and soon in the field of Telecommunications.  
 By offering reliable services that meet the ever-increasing energy needs of businesses and households, the Volton Group aims to build trusting relationships with consumers. The company's ambition is to become one of the most important companies in the sector and to remain at the forefront of developments as the first Multiservices Provider, combining Electricity, Natural Gas and Telecommunications.  As part of its growth, Volton is strengthening its human resources in Athens and is looking for:
 
Quality Assurance Specialist
Position Description:
The Quality Assurance Specialist as a member of the Quality Assurance team is responsible for measuring and monitoring the customer experience across all Volton customer service touch points. It highlights opportunities to improve service and supports having an active role in the development of processes and systems, with the aim of improving the experience throughout the customer journey.
Responsibilities:

Control and quality assessment of service contacts at all touch points (calls, written communication, social media)
Feedback to production teams and highlighting training needs
Analysis of findings and highlighting of pain points, utilizing all available measurement sources (transactional surveys, CX platform)
Active participation in CX actions (detractors analysis, voice of the customer) and in the development of automation tools for the service teams
Participation in the development and maintenance of the internal info portal of the service teams

 
Required Qualifications:

1+ year of relevant professional experience in a similar role
Excellent knowledge of English, both oral and written
Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Understanding of service processes and automation in a Contact Center environment
Flexibility, initiative and a customer-centric approach
Experience in the energy industry will be appreciated

Competitive remuneration package
